Commentary.Commentary: We are back for West Indies' second innings! The South African players make their way out to the middle, followed by Kraigg Brathwaite and Kieran Powell. Kagiso Rabada will start with the ball.

West Indies, on the other hand, bowled well. Kemar Roach was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up a 4-fer and was lethal. Kyle Mayers continued his good form with the ball in this game as he ended up with three while Holder got one. They would be disappointed though to give some easy runs towards the end and they need to bat really well if they want to chase this score down but first, they will need to face some tricky overs before Stumps on Day 3. Will they be able to go to Day 4 unscathed? We will find out.

South Africa rode on Rassie van der Dussen's knock to get a lead of 323. They started off poorly, losing Markram in the first over. Elgar, Petersen, Verreynne, de Kock and Maharaj could not do much as they were 73 for 7 at one stage but Kagio Rabada played a handy knock of 40. Rassie van der Dussen continued n his merry way and held South Africa get a good lead on this wicket.

South Africa will be happy with the lead here! They started off in poor fashion as they lost quick wickets and were reduced to 73 for 7 at one stage but Rassie van der Dussen and Kagiso Rabada ensured that that is not the case and they have gotten a very good score on the board. West Indies would need to bat really well if they want to win this game.

South Africa are still on top but they have been troubled here. They lost 6 wickets in quick succession and are slightly on the back foot. Aiden Markram fell in the first over while Dean Elgar stood for a while before he departed. Keegan Petersen looked good but did not do much while Kyle Verreynne struggled. Rassie van der Dussen is looking solid and he needs to stay out there. He would want support from his partners. Join us in a while to find out what happens in the final session.

Excellent session for West Indies! They bowled excellently and they were superb. They just did not give anything away. Kemar Roach started it all, as he sent Aiden Markram packing in the first over itself and then returned to send back Dean Elgar. Kyle Mayers was the other star as he picked up three wickets in what was a lovely spell of bowling. Jason Holder too was probing and got the wicket of Quinton de Kock. All-in-all it was a very good bowling performance.

OUT! CAUGHT AT SECOND SLIP! What a reply from Kemar Roach! End of a poor Test match for Aiden Markram. Good length ball on off, it moves away. Markram looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it goes towards second slip where Jason Holder takes a good catch diving to his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Kemar Roach
